description: 16:9 cover divided into 3 vertical thirds: cover frame (left) + main shot (center) + end scene (right). Panel 1 becomes transparent overlay, Panel 2/3 are Wan2.7 FL2V source/target.

defaults.lighting: soft rim light + golden hour tone

prompt_template: A 16:9 magazine cover layout divided into 3 vertical thirds for {product_name}. LEFT THIRD (Panel 1 - Cover Frame): clean composition with empty space for graphic design elements, product name and logo placement. CENTER THIRD (Panel 2 - Main Shot): {model_desc} {action_phrase} {product_short} at eye level, centered in frame, looking at camera with direct eye contact, bright smile. RIGHT THIRD (Panel 3 - End Scene): {model_desc} in similar pose holding {product_short}, subtle smile, ready-to-use or result pose. Both center and right thirds show model with product. {scene_description}. {lighting_cap}. Style: {style}, 16:9 aspect ratio, vertical triptych composition.
negative_prompt: blurry, low quality, deformed, watermark, text overlay, cropped face, ugly, disfigured, low resolution, bad anatomy, extra fingers, mutation, asymmetric panels, panels out of frame
